2026_03_SEA_WAS.headline: Darnold returns as Washington turns to Mariota against Seattle
2026_03_SEA_WAS.paragraph1: Sam Darnold is cleared to return for Seattle, while Washington will start Marcus Mariota with Jayden Daniels ruled out because of his left elbow injury. Mike Macdonald's Seahawks can test a Commanders offense also missing guard Samuel Cosmi and linebacker Frankie Luvu, though Seattle enters without starting safeties Julian Love and Ty Okada. Washington needs Mariota to keep the offense on schedule; Seattle's reshuffled secondary must prevent those manageable situations from becoming explosive plays.
2026_03_SEA_WAS.model_rationale: Seattle regains its starting quarterback while Washington changes quarterbacks and loses important supporting pieces, making protection, early-down execution and Seattle's replacement safeties central matchup variables.
